zia/locations.name: parentId
zia/locations.description: Parent location ID. If this ID does not exist or is 0, the location is a parent location; otherwise it is a sub-location whose parent has this ID.

zia/locations.name: tz
zia/locations.description: Timezone of the location. If not specified, it defaults to GMT.

zia/locations.name: ipAddresses
zia/locations.description: For locations, IP addresses of the egress points provisioned in the Zscaler Cloud; each entry is a single IP address.

zia/locations.name: ports
zia/locations.description: IP ports associated with the location.

zia/locations.name: profile
zia/locations.description: Profile tag that specifies the location traffic type. If not specified, this tag defaults to "Unassigned".

zia/locations.name: description
zia/locations.description: Additional notes or information regarding the location or sub-location. The description cannot exceed 1024 characters.

zia/locations.name: ipv6Enabled
zia/locations.description: If set to true, IPv6 is enabled for the location and IPv6 traffic from the location can be forwarded to the Zscaler service to enforce security policies.

zia/rule-labels.name: id
zia/rule-labels.description: The unique identifier for the rule label.

zia/rule-labels.name: lastModifiedTime
zia/rule-labels.description: Timestamp when the rule label was last modified.

zia/rule-labels.name: referencedRuleCount
zia/rule-labels.description: The number of rules that reference the label.

zia/url-filtering-rules.name: order
zia/url-filtering-rules.description: Order of execution of the rule with respect to other URL filtering rules.

zia/url-filtering-rules.name: action
zia/url-filtering-rules.description: Action taken when traffic matches the rule criteria.

zia/url-filtering-rules.name: urlCategories
zia/url-filtering-rules.description: List of URL categories for which the rule must be applied.

zia/url-filtering-rules.name: requestMethods
zia/url-filtering-rules.description: Request methods for which the rule must be applied. If not set, the rule is applied to all methods.

zia/url-filtering-rules.name: description
zia/url-filtering-rules.description: Additional information about the URL filtering rule.

zia/url-filtering-rules.name: blockOverride
zia/url-filtering-rules.description: When true, a BLOCK action triggered by the rule could be overridden.

zia/url-filtering-rules.name: labels
zia/url-filtering-rules.description: The URL filtering rule's labels; labels logically group policy rules.

zia/url-filtering-rules.name: locations
zia/url-filtering-rules.description: Name-ID pairs of locations for which the rule must be applied.
